body: > ℹ️ No critical issues — one toggle race worth a look. **Reviewed changes** Reviewed all four commits. Together they keep a webcam file running when the camera is turned off and on mid-take, and they mark each off period as a hidden segment in the editor. - **Park instead of destroy**: during an active take with a live webcam file, the hub now hides the bubble window and keeps it protected (`park`). Turning the camera back on shows the same window. A parked window is released at finalize, abort, stop and forced reset, and `placedBounds()` is read before that release. - **Bubble preview follows the toggle**: `useCameraOn` drives `useCameraPreview`, so a parked bubble releases the camera itself. - **Relay track in the engine**: the webcam encoder reads a `MediaStreamTrackGenerator` that is fed from the current camera. `frameRate` and `sizeChangeBehavior: "contain"` are both real mediabunny 1.61 options. `turnWebcamOff` / `turnWebcamOn` use `cameraRequest` so that a newer toggle supersedes an older one. - **Gap log in the store**: `WebcamGapLog` records off periods on the take's screen clock and sends them with finalize. If the camera fails to reopen, the existing "camera wasn't available" toast is shown. - **Sidecar and editor**: `sanitizeWebcamGaps` sorts, merges, clamps and caps the gaps. `seedWebcamScene` seeds each gap as a hidden segment stretched to the minimum segment length.   ｜ [Fix all ➔](https://pullfrog.com/trigger/niway-dev/kaipu-bench-pullfrog-v2/2?action=fix&review_id=5730804400) ｜ [Fix 👍s ➔](https://pullfrog.com/trigger/niway-dev/kaipu-bench-pullfrog-v2/2?action=fix-approved&review_id=5730804400) ｜ [View workflow run](https://github.com/niway-dev/kaipu-bench-pullfrog-v2/actions/runs/41362543016/job/125015796895) ｜ Using `claude-opus-5-5` ｜ [𝕏](https://x.com/pullfrogai)
